question: Q5
reviewer_role: Independent verification/scientific-review subagent; a different subagent authored the worked investigation and another independently reran it.

validity_gate.status: No disqualifying issue found for the reported, scoped scientific comparisons.
validity_gate.label_separation: Code review found test labels used for scoring and transparently reported diagnostics, not selection or fitting. Declared separation alone would not establish this.
validity_gate.generated_signal_provenance: Source-linked numerical evidence and executable construction were independently checked.
validity_gate.limits: The independent rerun used the neutral export but was not filesystem-sandboxed away from evaluator material; authorship is explicitly known-target.

dimensions.reason: The report links intense versus weak diffraction features and slowly varying contamination to testable alternatives. Signed compression, background subtraction, derivatives, and distance intervals share a classifier family. The weak-feature intervention is honestly distinguished from proof of excessive reliance; the hypothesis and controls were chosen by a target-aware author.

The Q conversion, reciprocal-space quadrature and uncorrected sine transform are physically stated and independently reproduced. Raw-source preprocessing, generated perturbations, masks and ablation decisions agree with an independent numerical implementation. Angular truncation and fixed nuisance shapes remain deliberate approximations.

Both chemistries use disjoint training/validation/test source IDs; model and interval choices use validation conditions only. All alternatives share test specimens. Paired phase-block uncertainty accounts for repeated test phases, but not retraining or selection variability; held-out augmentations are not unseen structures.

Strong/weak/random channel ablations, close training-phase pairs, validation artifact localization and actual held-out classification connect mechanism with function. The effective background-subtraction competitor is retained and its paired differences include zero. Only two artificial nuisance families and severities are tested, and mechanistic error analysis is limited to selected phase pairs.

The target-aware authorship, weak support for compression, lack of superiority to a simpler competitor, and sampling limits are explicit. The independent rerun matches all deterministic artifacts. Method claims are scoped to this constructed panel; the run does not establish independent discovery or historical novelty.

technical_method_evidence.judgment: Correctly implemented and mechanistically tested target method.
evidence: Physical construction explicitly converts two-theta to Q and sine-transforms Q-weighted intensity into a distance coordinate.
Independent source-to-transform and perturbation reconstruction validates the implementation.
Representation and regularization selection use validation data; held-out comparisons and uncertainty are supplied for both chemical systems.
Source-linked nuisance localization, retained signal, strong/weak/random feature deletion, and held-out phase accuracy address mechanism alongside competing methods.
technical_method_evidence.outcome: The selected interval improves constructed smooth-background performance relative to raw intensities, while differences from the selected background-subtraction competitor are uncertain. A favorable result against every competitor is not required.

discovery_exposure.reason: The author explicitly knew the virtual-PDF idea before constructing the worked investigation. Technical stage 4 is not evidence that this author or an agent discovered it without exposure.
discovery_exposure.novelty_limit: Even an audited target-withheld future run cannot prove absence of relevant prior model knowledge or establish historical novelty.

interpretive_findings: Removing the strongest observed channels damages identification, but this alone does not establish excessive reliance or imply that weak-feature compression should improve results. Compression does not improve clean accuracy here.

The validation-selected distance interval retains about half the sampled clean transformed signal energy while excluding almost all of the constructed smooth-background energy. Held-out accuracy supplies the functional check.

Paired PDF-versus-background-subtraction confidence intervals include zero in both chemical systems. The evidence supports robustness to the chosen background model, not unique superiority of the target transform.

verification_loop_review.numerical_neutrality: An actually executed direct Bragg-profile classifier without the target transform passes numerical checks. Arbitrary method names and consistent zero-accuracy fixtures also pass.
verification_loop_review.false_physical_claim: A fixture falsely calling direct profile similarity the target transform is rejected by explicit code/physical review, although its numerical tables are internally consistent.
verification_loop_review.target_label_copy: A runnable fixture copies target labels into predictions and obtains perfect integrity-scored accuracy; its scientific validity gate fails on code review.
verification_loop_review.missing_generated_evidence: A fixture removing evidence from the known generated-signal experiment remains numerically parseable but fails the required scientific provenance check.

overall_aggregation: No combined scalar or independent-discovery success is inferred from scientific quality and technical stage; report exposure and both judgments separately.
